test_case_name: Accept all cookies and verify banner closure on Guida ai servizi

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' on the cookie banner of the 'Guida ai servizi' page
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible on the 'Guida ai servizi' page

test_case_name: Access additional cookie options from parent to child page

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' on the cookie banner of the parent page
And then check that the user is redirected to the cookie policy page

test_case_name: Navigate from parent to Guida ai servizi via footer and download Consumatore guide

intents.intent: Click 'Guida ai servizi' link in the footer of the parent page
Click 'Scarica il file' for Consumatore on the 'Guida ai servizi' page
And then check that the Consumatore guide PDF is downloaded

test_case_name: Navigate from parent to Guida ai servizi via footer and download Business guide

intents.intent: Click 'Guida ai servizi' link in the footer of the parent page
Click 'Scarica il file' for Business on the 'Guida ai servizi' page
And then check that the Business guide PDF is downloaded

test_case_name: Perform a search on Guida ai servizi desktop

intents.intent: Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' search field on the 'Guida ai servizi' page
Click the 'btn-search' button to submit the search on the 'Guida ai servizi' page
And then check that the search results are displayed on the 'Guida ai servizi' page

test_case_name: Perform a search on Guida ai servizi mobile

intents.intent: Type $name into the 'Cerca' search field on the 'Guida ai servizi' page
Click the 'btn-search' button to submit the search on the 'Guida ai servizi' page
And then check that the search results are displayed on the 'Guida ai servizi' page

test_case_name: Login as guest on Guida ai servizi desktop

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' field on the guest login form of the 'Guida ai servizi' page

Click the 'ENTRA' button to submit the guest login form on the 'Guida ai servizi' page
And then check that the guest user is logged in on the 'Guida ai servizi' page
